title: Integrative Metabolomics and Machine Learning Approach to Uncover Scab Resistance Markers in Mature Pecan Trees
summary: Six metabolites were consistently ranked as resistance markers by both models, including syringin, proline and galactono-1,4-lactone; susceptible cultivars showed a different profile. The paper uses two collection years, 10-fold cross-validation, permutation testing and cross-year consistency filtering across 15 cultivars. It does not experimentally test causal roles of the metabolites or a breeding intervention; the small cultivar set limits generalization.
ai_technology: Support-vector-machine and random-forest classifiers distinguish resistant from susceptible cultivar metabolomes and rank metabolites as candidate resistance/susceptibility markers.
